CustomMetadata.label: Volunteers: rows leave with the person

values.value: Deleting a person deletes their volunteer requirements and volunteer skills, whoever deletes them, so a background check never outlives its person. Merging a duplicate keeps them: the merge moves them to the person kept. Restoring a person from the Recycle Bin does not bring them back. This automation enforces a rule, so it cannot be switched off here and pausing automation does not suspend it.
